item.title: Silencing GNU Dissidents a Litmus Test for Cyril Ramaphosa
item.description: President Cyril Ramaphosa and his Deputy Paul Mashatile at the GNU's cabinet lekgotla held at the Sefako Makgatho Presidential Guesthouse in Pretoria on September 30, 2025. The Cabinet Lekgotla must choose coherence over contestation, delivery over declaration, and collective responsibility over tactical positioning, says the writer.
